thread:
noah: Heads-up — seeing a 10-15% tail latency increase on runtime v3.5.1 for longseq workloads in eu-west during the midnight warmup window. Asking: should we temporarily freeze runtime version for model-group 'instruction-rerank' while we triage? change window 02:00–03:00 UTC.

liz: :eyes: can you drop the perf snippets + region-specific numbers?

noah: sure — link to quick dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/reports/longseq-eu-west
noah: snippet: ```p95 120ms -> 230ms; p99 210ms -> 480ms; model=instruction-rerank; runtime=v3.5.1; time=02:15UTC```

marie: runtime-oncall here — do we know if kv-cache behavior changed in 3.5.1 for long context? I remember a kernel tweak last week.

noah: we suspect a small regression in KV eviction heuristics causing spikes during warmup. Not seen in gcp-us or dedicated pools.

runtime-oncall: propose a region-scoped soft-freeze: pin eu-west traffic for that model-group to runtime v3.5.0 for the 02:00 window, keep other regions on 3.5.1. That reduces blast radius and avoids global rollback. :+1:

eng-release: if we do that, please include the fallback routing rule and the rollback command in the thread. We need a concise rollback plan in case p95 still spikes.

noah: suggested command to apply (test in staging first):
```
/deploybot pin runtime --region eu-west --model-group instruction-rerank --runtime v3.5.0 --until 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z --reason "warmup tail regression v3.5.1"
```

deploy-bot: queued action: pin-request received. Please confirm with `confirm-pin 3234567890` within 10 minutes or action will timeout.

liz: quick safety question — will the pin preserve dedicated pools or affect autoscale?

marie: the pin routes at the routing layer only, it won't change autoscale config. It should still respect pool reservations.

noah: rollback plan (if p95 > 200ms after pin):
- revert routes to 3.5.1 for eu-west: `/deploybot unpin runtime --region eu-west --model-group instruction-rerank`
- trigger canary-run of synthetic longseq queries in eu-west (link: synthetic job 88)
- alert oncall and open incident if p99 > 400ms for >5m

eng-release: add a short blurb to release-notes: "Temporary region-scoped runtime pin to v3.5.0 for instruction-rerank in eu-west due to warmup tail regression observed 02:15 UTC. Action window 02:00–03:00 UTC. Follow-up: triage KV heuristics." I can post the note after PR.

noah: i'm going to confirm the pin in 60s — staging run looks green. Confirming now.

deploy-bot: action confirmed by noah. Pin applied: runtime v3.5.0 for model-group instruction-rerank in eu-west. Started at 3234567945. Expires 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z.

liz: :thumbsup: will monitor dashboards and synthetic job. If anything odd, i will @runtime-oncall and escalate.

marie: i'll start a small investigation ticket for the KV eviction change and link profiling traces.

noah: thanks — will open the PR for release notes and put the rollback steps in Runbook.

eng-release: noted, will follow up with comms after midnight.

runtime-oncall: copying logs for triage: https://logs.redwood.example/q/longseq-eu-west/3234567890

noah: thread closed once we confirm steady p95 under 160ms for 15m."
